Celestron StarSense Explorer DX 130AZ

Your phone guides you to 100+ targets.

A 130mm reflector that uses your phone to plate-solve the sky and guide you to targets — training wheels that actually teach you the sky. Perfect first scope for someone whose interest started with 'what was that light?'

Why we like it

  • Phone-assisted finding really works
  • 130mm is a real step up from toy scopes
  • Light and genuinely portable

Keep in mind

  • Phone mount adds fiddliness
  • 130mm won't resolve fine planetary detail
  • Alt-azimuth mount, no tracking
